// diagnostic

E1319

`#Arg` has no CLI mapping for field `name`

What

`#Arg` has no CLI mapping for field `name`

Why

`#Arg` describes a generated command input. It does not apply outside a `#CLI` struct; its `env:` option also cannot map a presence-only `Bool` flag to the builder's value-option fallback.

Fix

Remove the marker, mark the command-input struct `#CLI`, or move `env:` to a value field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1319: tests/ui/cli_field_marker_misuse.stderr.

Error [jet.UnmappedCliMarker]: `#Arg` has no CLI mapping for field `port`
  --> tests/ui/cli_field_marker_misuse.jet:2:6
    |
  2 |     #Arg(short: "p") port: Int
    |      ^^^
 Why: `#Arg` describes a generated command input, but this struct is not `#CLI`.
 Fix: Remove the marker, or mark the command-input struct `#CLI`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1319

Error [jet.InvalidShortName]: `#Arg(short: "port")` is not a one-letter option
  --> tests/ui/cli_field_marker_misuse.jet:7:17
    |
  7 |     #Arg(short: "port") port: Int
    |                 ^^^^^^
 Why: The shared command parser treats a short option as one ASCII letter.
 Fix: Use one letter, such as `#Arg(short: "p")`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1318

Error [jet.UnmappedCliMarker]: `#Arg(env:)` has no CLI mapping for field `verbose`
  --> tests/ui/cli_field_marker_misuse.jet:8:15
    |
  8 |     #Arg(env: "VERBOSE") verbose: Bool
    |               ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `Bool` command field is a presence flag, while `env:` lowers to a value option.
 Fix: Remove `env:`, or use it on an `Int`, `Float`, `String`, `Path`, or optional value field
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1319
